meaning:
Group of ge.val (גְּבַל "Gebal" H1380)
§ Giblites = "a boundary"
inhabitants of Gebal

elsewhere.note: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;
Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.
